source: Li et al. 2024, Scientific Reports 14: 15241, Figure 8: Single MPT drawn against a stage timescale, Bremer and bootstrap values, 27 tips. Two places are drawn with crossing lines rather than a joining vertical: the ankylosaurs (read as ((Gastonia,Sauropelta),(Euoplocephalus,Paranthodon))) and the Baiyinosaurus clade (read as (Isaberrysaura,(Baiyinosaurus,Gigantspinosaurus)), which matches the text). Exclude those two splits if the reading is in doubt. Matrix spellings: D._armatus (printed Dacentrurus), S._stenops, S._homheni. Image: embedded image at native resolution, unmodified (1595x2124 px). Gold tree and name list from the Open Paleo corpus session (2026-10-29).
